description: Search open job postings read directly from employers' own Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever boards. Unlike a job board, every result carries the employer's real publish date and age in days, so you can tell a role posted this morning from one that has been open two years.

location.description: Any part of the location string, e.g. 'Berlin', 'California'

max_age_days.description: Only roles posted within this many days

min_age_days.description: Only roles OLDER than this many days -- use to hunt stale listings

query.description: Words in the job title, e.g. 'staff backend engineer'

technology.description: Technology named in the posting, e.g. 'Python', 'Kubernetes'

name: search_jobs
